dct_description_sm: Nigeria administrative level 0-3 boundaries (COD-AB) dataset version 01. This dataset is structured into 3 levels: - Admin 1: 37 State - Admin 2: 774 Local Governement Area - Admin 3: 714 Ward, partial coverage Dates associated with this dataset: - 30 October 2025: dataset reviewed for accuracy and completeness - 17 April 2019: valid for use by the humanitarian community - 01 October 1996: last edit to the dataset before publishing - 01 October 1996: boundaries created by the source Contributed by [OCHA Nigeria](https://data.humdata.org/organization/ocha-nigeria). Quality assured, configured, and published by [OCHA Field Information Services (FIS)](https://data.humdata.org/organization/ocha-fiss) and [HDX](https://data.humdata.org/organization/hdx). Part of the dataset: [Global Subnational Administrative Boundaries](https://data.humdata.org/dataset/cod-ab-global)
dct_publisher_sm: Office for the Surveyor General of the Federation of Nigeria (OSGOF), Ehealth, United Nations Cartographic Section (UNCS)
